forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: '[Multitool] Wall-clock Promise.all concurrency test is load-sensitive'
+---
+Observed while running the ungated suite for `^0981ar3` (2026-08-08).
+
+`MultiToolExecutionTests` — "Promise.all over two slow tools.* calls completes in ~max, not ~sum, of their durations" — failed once with `Expectation failed: elapsed < .milliseconds(280)`, measured 303 ms, and passed on the runs immediately before and after with no code change between them. The failure is a wall-clock threshold under machine load, not a concurrency defect: the same code measured well under the gate on the neighbouring runs.
+
+The gate is the problem, not the number. A pass/fail that depends on how busy the box is makes an ungated suite non-deterministic, and raising the threshold only moves the load level at which it lies. What the test wants to prove is that two independent `tools.*` calls overlap rather than serialize, which is a *relation* between two measurements (elapsed vs. the sum of the two durations), not an absolute millisecond budget.
+
+## What
+
+Make the assertion structural rather than a wall-clock budget. Options to weigh:
+
+- Compare elapsed against the fixtures' own durations — assert it is nearer `max` than `sum` (e.g. below the midpoint) rather than below a fixed constant, so the claim scales with whatever the fixture sleeps for.
+- Have the fixture tools record their own entry/exit instants and assert the two intervals *overlap*. That is the actual claim ("they ran at the same time") and it holds at any speed.
+
+The second is the truer signal and the repo now has the machinery for it: `ScenarioCallLog` in the integration target already records per-invocation outcomes, and the main target's fixtures can record instants the same way.
+
+Do not raise the threshold and do not add a retry.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The test's assertion no longer rests on an absolute millisecond budget
+- [ ] It still fails if the two calls serialize (show it, by making the fixtures serialize in a scratch edit)
+- [ ] Ungated `swift test` green, zero warnings
+</description>
+<parameter name="tags">["phase-1"]
\ No newline at end of file
